svg.aria-label: Two families of routing algorithms. Link-state: every router floods its links to all others, so each has the full map and runs Dijkstra. Distance-vector: each router only tells its neighbours its current distances, and they update with Bellman-Ford until values settle.
svg.title: Two families of routing algorithms. Link-state: every router floods its links to all others, so each has the full map and runs Dijkstra. Distance-vector: each router only tells its neighbours its current distances, and they update with Bellman-Ford until values settle.
svg.text: everyone floods its links to everyone
→ each router has the whole map
